newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Hai Xing in transfer of control.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Hai Xing in transfer of control.

text.p: Shanghai Hai Xing Shipping Co Ltd said on Friday its parent Shanghai Shipping (Group) Co would transfer a controlling 56.45 percent stake in the company to China Shipping (Group) Co.
China Shipping, a wholly-owned unit of China's Ministry of Communications, controls Shanghai Shipping.

The company said Shanghai Shipping would on July 18 enter into an agreement to transfer its holding of 1.4 billion domestic shares, which were not listed on any stock exchange in China, of Shanghai Hai Xing to China Shipping.

The transfer of shares is conditional upon approval of the China State-owned Assets Administration Bureau and the grant of a wavier by the Hong Kong Securities & Futures Commission of requiring China Shipping to make a general offer to holders of the company's H-shares listed in Hong Kong, it said.

Shanghai Hai Xing also said president and a senior economist of China Shipping, Li Kelin, would be elected as the company's chairman in a forthcoming extraordinary general meeting to be held on August 26. Li Shaode will resign as chairman but will be re-elected deputy chairman, it added.
The company name is proposed to be changed to China Shipping Development Co Ltd, it said.
